decision_levels._note: At which point in the chain each variable governs a decision (Fresco).

note: Two FUNDAMENTALLY different kinds of variable. The deviation policy is the distinction: identity deviations reject the material (never compensated by changing the formula); process deviations are adjusted and re-tested. Do NOT generalize beyond scope_verified.

identity.definition: Defines the identity of the raw material. Set before production; not produced by it.
identity.policy: Out-of-spec identity → Reject Material. NO formula compensation.

appearance_uniformity.meaning: no lumps / no phase separation (NOT color)
